outcome: Successful vaginal delivery beyond 34 weeks of gestation
cohort: 90 singleton pregnancies delivered at a single center between July 2019 and August 2020
finding: A posterior cervical angle of 96.5° or greater, as measured by transvaginal ultrasound, was associated with successful vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: A posterior cervical angle ≥96.5° was associated with successful vaginal delivery.
